newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends firmer on further covering.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends firmer on further covering.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jan (3rd pos) 1,190 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,185 *
Open/hi/low 1,176/1,190/1,175 Prev close 1,170
Prev settlement 1,170 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended firmer on further covering and renewed speculative buying, helped by overnight rally in Chicago soybean futures, larger-than-expected exports and anticipation of big drop in November output. Immediate upside for January contract seen capped at 1,200 ringgit.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also firmed on covering by refiners and China's inquiry for 5,000 tonnes palm olein.

Cargo surveyor Caleb Brett has estimated exports in the first 10 days of November at 207,000 tonnes, which, although smaller than for the same period in October, were higher than what the market had expected.
Malaysian private forecaster Ivan Wong will release his final crop estimates for October on Thursday while official Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) figures are due on Friday.
Traders said some players were expecting a double-digit percentage drop in November production from October. Ivan Wong had earlier estimated output in October at 880,000 tonnes.
January crude palm oil futures closed up 20 ringgit at 1,190 ringgit ($471.47) a tonne. Traders said immediate upside for the contract is likely to be capped at 1,200 ringgit.
Volume on the futures market was 1,975 lots against 1,031 lots on Tuesday.
Physicals prices also firmed on covering by refiners and Chinese interest. Traders said China is seeking 5,000 tonnes of palm olein for November/December shipment.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,185 ringgit ($469.49) a tonne with bids at 1,180, after trading from 1,175 to 1,180.
Nov (central) was offered at 1,175 with bids at 1,167.50, and traded from 1,162.50 to 1,170.
Nov (north) saw offers at 1,165 and bids at 1,155.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,200 ringgit with bids at 1,195. It was traded from 1,190 to 1,195.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,195 and bids at 1,185.
Trades among refined products were confined to RBD palm olein.
Nov palm olein was offered at $547.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Dec and Jan/Feb/Mar at $545. Dec was traded at $539 and $540, and Jan/Feb/Mar at $540.
Nov RBD palm oil was offered at $512.50, and Dec and Jan/Feb/Mar at $510.
Nov RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $372.50, Dec at $377.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $385.
Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $310.
